name: 库多西
evolution: 多西 → 库多西 Lv.32 → 波多西 Lv.48
description: 兼具岩石的稳固与钢铁的坚韧，身上带有厚重的泥土气味，推测是因为习惯在地底休眠所致。能够利用磁场的力量发动攻击，但也会在特殊磁场的影响下动弹不得，因此总是在人烟稀少的地方栖息。
descriptionEn: It combines the solidity of rock with the toughness of steel and carries a heavy smell of earth, presumably because it is used to dormancy underground. It can attack using the power of magnetic fields, but it can also be rendered immobile under the influence of special magnetic fields, which is why it always inhabits sparsely populated places.

skills.name: 啮合传递
skills.description: 自己获得速度+30，本技能位于1号或3号位时额外获得物攻+80%，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains Speed +30; when this skill is in slot 1 or 3, additionally gains Physical ATK +80%; transmission 1.

skills.name: 能量守恒
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：两侧技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; counters attacks: the energy cost of the skills on both sides is permanently -1.

skills.name: 齿轮扭矩
skills.description: 造成物伤，每回合位置发生变化时，本技能威力永久+15。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; whenever its position changes each turn, this skill’s power permanently +15.

skills.name: 轴承支撑
skills.description: 主动：本技能被动永久额外-1能耗，被动：两侧技能能耗-1，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Active: this skill’s passive permanently gains an additional -1 energy cost. Passive: energy cost of the skills on both sides -1; transmission 1.

skills.name: 鸣沙陷阱
skills.description: 造成物伤，物防比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the higher your Physical DEF compared with the enemy, the higher this skill’s power.

skills.name: 蓄势待发
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains 1 layer of Momentum Mark.

skills.name: 壁垒
skills.description: 减伤90%，应对攻击：防御技能冷却-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 90%; counters attacks: defense skill cooldown -1.

skills.name: 钢钻
skills.description: 造成物伤，技能威力为两侧技能威力和的三分之一，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the skill’s power is one third of the combined power of the skills on both sides; transmission 1.

skills.name: 绞轮
skills.description: 造成物伤，每受到1次抵抗的技能攻击（不含连击），本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; for each resisted skill attack taken (multi-hits excluded), this skill’s energy cost permanently -1.

skills.name: 齿轮切开
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能位于1号或3号位时能耗-2，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when this skill is in slot 1 or 3, energy cost -2; transmission 1.

skills.name: 岩土暴击
skills.description: 造成物伤，每被攻击1次。本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; for each time it is attacked, this skill’s energy cost permanently -1.

skills.name: 地震
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 地刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; counters status: additionally interrupts the countered skill.
